_about: Checks made by hand on regulator websites that block automated access. Each check names the listing page, the screenshot kept in sources/evidence/, and, for each instrument it covers, the newest edition the listing showed. Add a new check (newest first) whenever a page is checked again; see docs/CONTENT_GUIDE.md.
